'Tested' here = the Tailwind 4 theme compiles the token utilities during `npm run build` and app/ lints clean; there is no unit/visual test runner for CSS in this repo (see docs/qa/test-plans/design-system.md#tc-1).

requirements.notes: Marked spec_compliant:false because the requirement asks the color palette to meet WCAG AA in both themes and two token pairs do NOT: --faint (2.74:1 light / 3.81:1 dark) and --accent-on-bg (~3.7:1) are below the 4.5:1 normal-text AA threshold. Per review finding CR-001 (severity low, status open) these are an exact verbatim port of the frozen DESIGN §3 tokens, not a porting error, and no component consumes --faint (or accent-colored small text) yet. Body/label/muted text passes AA in BOTH themes (see measurements). The focus outline uses --accent as a non-text UI cue where the 3:1 non-text threshold applies. The 'badges never rely on color alone' clause is a component-layer obligation (tokens provide distinct --good/--warn/--bad/--err + -bg pairs to combine with label+icon) and is not yet exercisable at this CSS-foundation layer — it will be re-evaluated when result badges ship. 'Tested' here = contrast computed by hand for every text/surface pair (documented in docs/qa/test-plans/design-system.md#tc-1); there is no automated a11y/visual test runner in this repo. Constraint to carry downstream: do not use --faint or accent-colored small copy for meaningful text without a non-color cue and/or a larger size.
